reason: Both conversations correctly identified the door interlock/latch as the likely cause and gave the same sensible first step of cleaning the hooks and slots. Conversation 1 ended abruptly with a 'close it firmly' test and never addressed door alignment, escalation to an engineer, or the fact that this cannot be confirmed remotely. Conversation 2 explored door alignment, kept both switch and latch hypotheses open, explicitly warned against opening the casing due to mains/high-voltage risk, and appropriately escalated to Bosch Service once the homeowner said he would pay for a visit, matching the ground truth that an engineer with access to the unit is required.
